images.caption: Araraquara is a city in the state of São Paulo in Brazil. It is also known as "the abode of the sun," because of its impressive sunset and because of its hot atmosphere, especially in summer. Ferroviária is the local football (soccer) team of the city. The club plays home matches at Estádio Fonte Luminosa, which has a maximum capacity of 27,000 people.

images.caption: The São Paulo Cathedral (Catedral Metropolitana Nossa Senhora da Assunção e São Paulo), informally known as Catedral da Sé, is the main Catholic temple of the city of São Paulo, Brazil. It is located on Praça da Sé, in the central zone of the municipality.
